title: 18beta-glycyrrhetinic acid mitigates lipotoxicity-induced premature senescence of tubular epithelial cells by activating SIRT1-TFEB signaling.
authors: Yang, Meng; Qin, Weihong; Dai, Qihui; Wu, Shengquan; Chen, Yuzhi; Xie, Weiheng; Jiang, Xiaoyun; Song, Haochang; Lei, Yiting; Zheng, Tingting; Wang, Yanyan; Ouyang, Suidong; Guan, Min; Huang, Gonghua; Liu, Xinguang
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究18β-甘草次酸通过SIRT1-TFEB信号改善肾小管细胞脂毒性衰老，虽涉及TFEB蛋白与SIRT1互作及分子对接，但核心是疾病治疗机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Targeting metabolic disorders has emerged as a promising therapeutic strategy in the treatment of chronic kidney disease (CKD). 18beta-glycyrrhetinic acid (18beta-GA) is known for its metabolic regulatory and antioxidant effects in various diseases. However, the precise effects and underlying mechanisms of 18beta-GA on CKD remain unclear. PURPOSE: This study aims to evaluate the therapeutic efficacy of 18beta-GA on CKD and to identify the molecular targets of 18beta-GA with a particular emphasis on its role in metabolic regulation. STUDY DESIGN AND METHODS: A high-fat diet-induced CKD model was established to investigate the influence of 18beta-GA on lipid metabolic disorders, cellular senescence and fibrosis in the kidneys. Co-immunoprecipitation was performed to investigate the impact of 18beta-GA on the interaction between transcription factor EB (TFEB) and sirtuin 1 (SIRT1). Additionally, network pharmacology and molecular docking analyses were conducted to identify the specific target proteins of 18beta-GA. RESULTS: 18beta-GA alleviated renal lipid accumulation, tubular cell senescence and renal interstitial fibrosis in CKD mice. Treatment with 18beta-GA largely restored mitochondrial function and attenuated intracellular lipotoxicity and associated cellular senescence by promoting lipophagy in renal tubular cells. Mechanistically, 18beta-GA acting as a partial antagonist of peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPARgamma) enhanced lipophagy through SIRT1-mediated nuclear translocation of TFEB which induced the expression of microtubule-associated protein light chain 3 (LC3). CONCLUSION: Our findings demonstrate that 18beta-GA, functioning as a partial antagonist of PPARgamma, counteracts CKD progression by activating the SIRT1-TFEB-LC3 signaling axis-mediated lipophagy and thus uncover a novel mechanism by which 18beta-GA improves renal lipid metabolism disorders and exerts renoprotective effects. These results highlight the potential of 18beta-GA as a promising therapeutic agent for the treatment and prevention of CKD.
abstract_zh: 背景：靶向代谢紊乱已成为治疗慢性肾脏病（CKD）的一种有前景的治疗策略。18β-甘草次酸（18β-GA）因其在多种疾病中的代谢调节和抗氧化作用而闻名。然而，18β-GA对CKD的确切作用及其潜在机制仍不清楚。目的：本研究旨在评估18β-GA对CKD的治疗效果，并确定18β-GA的分子靶点，特别关注其在代谢调节中的作用。研究设计与方法：建立高脂饮食诱导的CKD模型，以研究18β-GA对肾脏脂质代谢紊乱、细胞衰老和纤维化的影响。采用免疫共沉淀法研究18β-GA对转录因子EB（TFEB）与去乙酰化酶1（SIRT1）之间相互作用的影响。此外，通过网络药理学和分子对接分析，鉴定18β-GA的特异性靶蛋白。结果：18β-GA减轻了CKD小鼠的肾脏脂质积累、肾小管细胞衰老和肾间质纤维化。18β-GA处理通过促进肾小管细胞中的脂自噬，显著恢复线粒体功能，并减轻细胞内脂毒性和相关细胞衰老。机制上，18β-GA作为过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ（PPARγ）的部分拮抗剂，通过SIRT1介导的TFEB核转位增强脂自噬，从而诱导微管相关蛋白轻链3（LC3）的表达。结论：我们的研究结果表明，18β-GA作为PPARγ的部分拮抗剂，通过激活SIRT1-TFEB-LC3信号轴介导的脂自噬来对抗CKD进展，从而揭示了18β-GA改善肾脏脂质代谢紊乱并发挥肾脏保护作用的新机制。这些结果突显了18β-GA作为治疗和预防CKD的有前景的治疗药物的潜力。
